tasks.brief: Implementation constraints: Create a new file src/static/rain.js. Use only vanilla JavaScript (no libraries). Must be wrapped in an IIFE. Behavioral specification: Implement the Matrix Rain canvas animation per the ERD skeleton. Key details: 1. Create a canvas with data-testid='matrix-rain', fixed position, inset 0, z-index 0, pointer-events none, opacity 0.35. 2. Use katakana (0x30A0-0x30FF) + digits 0-9 as glyphs. 3. Animation loop: clear with rgba(0,0,0,0.08), draw green text, draw brighter head (globalAlpha 0.9), update drops. 4. Handle resize and visibilitychange. 5. Expose window.MatrixRain = { start, stop }. 6. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (draw one frame, no loop). 7. stop() cancels raf and hides canvas. Acceptance condition: The file exists, contains the IIFE, exposes window.MatrixRain with start/stop, and uses requestAnimationFrame.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/style.css. Append a new block. Do not modify existing rules. Behavioral specification: Add a [data-theme="phosphor"] block. 1. Set CSS variables: background oklch(0.16 0.02 155), foreground oklch(0.9 0.16 150), primary/accent-strong oklch(0.82 0.24 148), secondary accent oklch(0.75 0.19 165), cards oklch(0.20 0.025 155), borders 18% alpha primary, inputs 12%, focus ring 60%. 2. Override border-radius to 0.25rem. 3. Set font-family to ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace. 4. Add scanline overlay on chat panel via ::before with repeating-linear-gradient (2px period, low alpha, pointer-events none). 5. Add text glow on assistant text/headers (text-shadow 0 0 6px currentColor). 6. Add .box-glow class (green ring + outer glow). 7. Ensure app chrome sits above rain (position relative, z-index 1 on app wrapper if not already). Acceptance condition: The CSS file contains the [data-theme="phosphor"] block with the specified variables, fonts, and visual effects.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/index.html. Locate the script tag for app.js. Behavioral specification: Insert <script src="/static/rain.js"></script> immediately BEFORE the app.js script tag. Do not modify any other part of the file. Acceptance condition: The HTML file contains the rain.js script tag before app.js.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/app.js. Modify the THEMES array and applyTheme function. Behavioral specification: 1. In the THEMES array, add 'phosphor' after 'matrix'. 2. Add its icon mapping to THEME_ICONS (e.g., '𐌘' or '>_'). 3. In applyTheme(), after setting data-theme, if theme === 'phosphor', call window.MatrixRain.start() (guard with typeof window.MatrixRain !== 'undefined'). Else, call window.MatrixRain.stop(). Acceptance condition: The app.js file includes 'phosphor' in THEMES, its icon in THEME_ICONS, and calls MatrixRain.start/stop in applyTheme based on the theme.
